verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI is fundamentally API/library-first: core crawling, extraction, LLM extraction, deep-crawl, and adaptive crawling are all driven through the Python API and CLI, with Docker/FastAPI server and MCP support for programmatic/agent access. There's no separate full-featured GUI whose capabilities are withheld from the API—the only 'UI' element (a monitoring dashboard) is a supplementary view, not a distinct feature surface.
